propositions: COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE instructs FAIL callers to add concrete ticket-comment evidence on retry but omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite required by ADR 0043 for external evidence to be admissible

An untagged external criterion is deliberately classified as codebase-verifiable by contract and cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone, yet the remediation guidance does not state this limitation

The operator followed incomplete remediation guidance, added concrete evidence in a ticket comment without the [operator-attested] tag, and incurred a second FAIL that was contractually correct but avoidable
Remediation guidance must distinguish repository-verifiable evidence from external operator-attested evidence and name the exact tag prerequisite to avoid directing callers to futile retries
